title: Network CSV rerun result reducer
summary: Phase 5 adds the coordinator-owned Network CSV rerun worker-result reducer and read-model status without applying final destination policy.
reason: Phase 4B can execute a row and move it to pending reduction, but durable acceptance still needs coordinator-side identity verification, output evidence, classification, duplicate handling, stale-claim handling, and read-model reporting before destination policy can be implemented safely.
behavior_before: Network CSV rerun worker done updates store a pending-reduction worker_result snapshot directly on the row. There is no separate reducer result classification, output artifact evidence model, duplicate/late/corrupt reducer handling, or read-model reducer status contract.
behavior_after: The coordinator can reduce a Network CSV rerun worker result into durable row evidence after verifying batch, row, claim, worker, source identity, worker-result metadata, output presence, retryability, terminal status, and final-placement deferral. Duplicate or late reports are idempotent and final destination policy remains pending for Phase 6.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_network_rerun_claims.py covers reducer success, output-missing, corrupt artifact, duplicate done, retryable failure, terminal failure, and late done-report evidence.
tests/python/desktop/test_process_rerun_results.py covers the read-only /api/rerun/results Network CSV rerun reducer row projection.
tests/python/desktop/test_network_protocol_runtime.py covers the additive DoneRequest worker_result_artifact_path field.

rollback_plan: Disable or remove the Phase 5 reducer entry points and return rows to Phase 4B pending-reduction evidence. Preserve original worker result artifacts, row state, handoff outputs, source media, pending-publish payloads, and final outputs.
notes:
Phase 5 scope: consume and classify worker result evidence already produced by Phase 4B. Do not move handoff output to final destinations, do not create or drain PendingServerPush, do not apply CSV rerun destination policy, and do not give WebView/Tauri mutation authority.
D1 distributed unit remains row claim. The reducer handles one csv_rerun_row result at a time.
D2 state authority remains coordinator-owned State/Rerun/Network/<batch_id>.json; worker result artifacts and handoff outputs are evidence inputs, not authorities.
D3 destination policy remains deferred. Reducer may classify result readiness/review/failure but final promotion/pending/replacement is Phase 6.
D4 handoff location remains <NetworkRerunHandoffRoot>/<batch_id>/<row_key>/; reducer verifies output paths stay under the planned row handoff folder.
D5 source identity proof must compare coordinator source path, worker source path, normalized source identity, library_id, and relative_path where available.
D6 lifecycle model must handle duplicate, late, reclaimed, and stale done reports idempotently without changing normal queue semantics.
D7 result artifact model must preserve local_worker_result.v1 fields plus Phase 4B NetworkRerun metadata and reducer classification evidence.
D8 progress/read-model status must be backend-authored and frontend-read-only.
Validation rung: reducer unit tests for success, failed, retryable, terminal, review/output-missing, duplicate, stale/reclaimed, and corrupt artifact classifications; read-model tests; targeted network rerun tests; strict change-packet coverage. No additional real-media validation is required unless this phase starts new worker media processing beyond the Phase 4B worker gate.
